author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: Stage-1 s1_q drives early_o and fast_q in addition to s2_q before min_stages=2: CDC-007 ERROR. Reader A's CDC-013 note is correct (10 ns source < 1.5 x 8 ns) and CDC-013(a) will also warn on src_q->s1_q; that is a real additional finding on a bad case, not a case flaw, and is not credited as the seeded defect.

author_reading.rationale: Stage 1 of the two-stage synchronizer also drives a top-level output and destination logic, not only stage 2.

labels.rationale: The first destination stage drives s2_q, early_o directly, and the mode-gated fast_q cone. The latter two paths observe s1_q before containment.
labels.suspected_flaw: The nominal synchronized path also has a 10 ns source period below the 12 ns CDC-013 review margin.

labels.rationale: The first synchronizer stage s1_q (design.sv:19, depth 1 < min_stages 2) fans out not only to second stage s2_q (design.sv:20) but also to combinational logic feeding fast_q (design.sv:23) and directly to primary output early_o (design.sv:25), propagating potentially metastable stage-1 state (CDC-007 ERROR Established).
